Interface Applicative<F>

All Superinterfaces:
Functor<F>
All Known Subinterfaces:
ApplicativeError<F,E>, Async<F>, Bracket<F,E>, Concurrent<F>, ConcurrentEffect<F>, Effect<F>, Monad<F>, MonadError<F,E>, Sync<F>
All Known Implementing Classes:
Instances.CallableInstances, Instances.ListInstances, Instances.OptionalInstances, IO.IOConcurrent
public interface Applicative<F> extends Functor<F>
A Functor that can lift plain values and combine independent Fs.
